author: Luna Engine Team
opening_text: Find a way to the garden.
help_text: Try examine the room, and interacting with what you see!
unknown_command_text: I couldn't match that command. Try help, or use a visible object's name.

endings.name: A quiet moment
endings.text: You stop to admire the rose. For now, this is enough.

endings.name: Stolen
endings.text: You stop to admire the rose. Avoiding the thorns carefully, you pick it. A thought crosses your mind. You wont be able to enjoy the same moment of serenity tomorrow, and that maybe the rose was best left alone, to be admired for the weeks to come.

endings.name: A wonderful afternoon!
endings.text: The sun is shining in the garden, you reunited Tom with his favorite toy, you admire the rose, beautiful and vibrant red.
